title: 第17章 邀约第18章 境界与格局
content_zh:
林云仅仅是通过他这一个失落的眼神，便能清晰地感知到，他与自己有着诸多相似之处。
他同样渴望着，外面更为精彩的世界，同样渴望变得无比强大，同样不甘于平庸！
“陈渊兄，我这一次正是出来闯荡的，既然如此，何不与我一同前行？”
林云诚挚地发出邀请。
在这广袤无垠，且充满未知的宇宙海中，两个来自初级星系的神境修士，若能一起闯荡，无疑能为彼此增添一份力量和帮助。
“我最近，确实在认真考虑，出去闯荡的事宜。”
“我蓝墨羽星系，如今有两位神境，另一位是一级神境，他踏入神境的时间尚短，我打算将星核交予他。”
“如此一来，方能确保星核的安全。”
陈渊缓缓说道。
顿了顿，陈渊继续讲述道：“在我之前，我们蓝墨羽星系，曾经诞生过三位神境。”
“第一位神境叫蓝墨羽。
他乃是我们整个星系，最具传奇色彩的人物！”
“曾经，我们星系惨遭外来种族统治，人族生活在水深火热之中。”
“正是蓝墨羽前辈，挺身而出，带领我们星系的人族，浴血奋战，最终成功打败了其他种族，夺回了属于我们的整个星系！”
“他是我们蓝墨羽星系人族，当之无愧的英雄！”
“自那以后，为了铭记他的丰功伟绩，这个星系的名称，便以他来命名！”
“看那边，那里就是蓝墨羽前辈的雕像。”
陈渊将手，指向不远处的地方。
林云顺着他手指的方向看去，果然瞧见一个足有几十米高的白色雕塑，昂首挺胸地屹立于山巅。
那雕塑栩栩如生，仿佛在诉说着他往昔的辉煌。

“陈渊兄，那之后呢？”
林云好奇询问。
陈渊刚刚讲述的事迹，自然勾起了林云心中的好奇心。
林云坚信，他口中这位蓝墨羽前辈，定然有着一段极为辉煌、传奇的故事。
陈渊端着酒杯，继续讲述起来：
“蓝墨羽前辈在成为星主后的第二十三万年，毅然将星主之位，让给了另外一位新诞生的神境，然后离开蓝墨羽星系，前去闯荡宇宙海。”
“在那之后，蓝墨羽星系，又历经了两位星主，最终才传到我手中。”
林云听到这里后，不禁急切地追问：“那这位蓝墨羽前辈，如今身在何处？”
content_en:
Just by looking at his disappointed look, Lin Yun could clearly sense that he had many similarities with himself.
He also longs for a more exciting world outside, also longs to become extremely powerful, and is also unwilling to settle for mediocrity!
"Brother Chen Yuan, I am here to make a fortune this time. In that case, why don't you go forward with me?"
Lin Yun sincerely extended the invitation.
In this vast and unknown cosmic sea, if two god-level monks from primary galaxies can venture together, they will undoubtedly add strength and help to each other.
"Recently, I have really been seriously considering going out for a living."
"In our Lan Moyu galaxy, there are currently two gods. The other one is a first-level god. He has only entered the god realm for a short time. I plan to hand over the star core to him."
"In this way, the safety of the star core can be ensured."
Chen Yuan said slowly.
After a pause, Chen Yuan continued: "Before me, three gods were born in our Blue Moyu Galaxy."
“The first divine realm is named Lan Moyu.
He is the most legendary figure in our entire galaxy! "
"Once upon a time, our galaxy was ruled by alien races, and the human race lived in dire straits."
"It was Senior Lan Moyu who stepped forward and led the human race in our galaxy to fight bloody battles. Finally, he successfully defeated other races and took back the entire galaxy that belongs to us!"
"He is our human race in the Blue Ink Feather Galaxy, a well-deserved hero!"
"Since then, in order to remember his great achievements, this galaxy has been named after him!"
"Look over there, there is the statue of Senior Lan Moyu."
Chen Yuan pointed his hand to a place not far away.
Lin Yun looked in the direction of his finger, and sure enough he saw a white sculpture dozens of meters high, standing on the top of the mountain with its head held high.
The sculpture is lifelike, as if telling his past glory.
"Brother Chen Yuan, what happens next?"
Lin Yun asked curiously.
The deeds Chen Yuan just told naturally aroused Lin Yun's curiosity.
Lin Yun firmly believed that the senior Lan Moyu he mentioned must have an extremely glorious and legendary story.
Chen Yuan held the wine glass and continued to talk:
"On the 230,000th year after becoming Star Lord, Senior Lan Moyu resolutely gave up the position of Star Lord to another newly born god, and then left the Lan Moyu Galaxy to explore the cosmic sea."
"After that, the Blue Ink Feather Galaxy passed through two more star masters before it was finally passed to me."
After Lin Yun heard this, he couldn't help asking eagerly: "Where is this senior Lan Moyu now?"
